meta.source: Derived metadata coded from QP+MS (8300/3H). No exam text transcribed.
meta.note: Coding rules: (1) static diagrams ARE app-supported via existing image_url rendering. (2) exact_surd covers exact-symbolic answers incl. 'in terms of pi'. (3) MC-incidental (tick/circle whose real credit is in working or a worded reason/decision) is recoded to the genuine assessable form and app_supported reflects that form. (4) genuine MC/select = the choice IS the whole assessable answer. (5) Paper 3 is a calculator paper: computational parts calc, drawing/reasoning na. (6) inequalities/equations/factorisations coded answer_form 'expression'; plotting/drawing coded draw_plot/draw_shape; tree/region number entry coded table_complete; matching coded set_select; ratio answers coded 'ratio'. (7) open-ended 'give any value that satisfies...' answers are app no because exact-match cannot validate a family of correct responses.
